rv.q: Her play is hugely enjoyable for its malign vigour and the way it playfully mashes up genres, and for some arresting performances.
By the end, the notion of trauma is stark for all four characters and a horrified audience to see.
Consumed is a fast, thoughtful show with important things to say.
In covering such a broad range of topics from mental health to body positivity to vegetarianism to unfaithful significant others, the storyline might have benefited from substantial trimming.

cn.t: Kelly's dark comedy about intergenerational trauma in Northern Ireland draws mixed reviews. Critics note uneven storytelling but praise the obsidian-black humor and gripping exploration of family secrets across four generations of women.
